subject.title: fix(reef): keep routine agent replies from disappearing

question: Should Reef treat an approved signed peer as trusted enough for ordinary task-shaped collaboration while denying only explicit policy override, hidden-context, secret, and unauthorized-action requests?
rationale: Source review can assess correlation and state mechanics, but the acceptable level of agent steering from an approved remote peer is a product security boundary that requires explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve with live boundary proof
options.body: Keep the new rubric and durable feedback flow after adversarial two-peer proof confirms protected requests remain denied and routine collaboration succeeds.

options.title: Ship feedback without relaxation
options.body: Retain the existing broad fail-closed inbound rubric while landing only correlated rejection visibility and restart-safe notice handling.

options.title: Narrow allowed collaboration
options.body: Permit conversational coordination but keep imperative edit, execute, or action requests in owner review until a tighter capability contract exists.

recommendation.title: Approve with live boundary proof
recommendation.body: Keep the new rubric and durable feedback flow after adversarial two-peer proof confirms protected requests remain denied and routine collaboration succeeds.
